Massimo Cuttitta | Massimo Cuttitta (born in Latina, 2 September 1966) is a former Italian rugby union footballer and a current coach.  He used to play as a prop.  He's also the twin brother of Marcello Cuttitta.

Giuseppe Giordano | Giuseppe Giordano (born July 16, 1974 in Naples) is an Italian sport shooter.  He won a bronze medal in the men's free pistol at the 2011 ISSF World Cup series in Munich, Germany, with a total score of 659.6 points, earning him a spot on the Italian team for the Olympics.  Giordano is also a member of the shooting team for Centro Sportivo Esercito, and is coached and trained by Marco Masetti.
